messages:
samir.k: kicking off production deploy for release candidate `redwood-inference:v2.4.7-rc3` during tonight's change window (02:00-03:00 UTC). Need SBOM + vuln signoff before I hit promote. cc @todd.security @lauren
lauren: got it. last CI vuln scan looked clean except for one dependency note. do we have SBOM uploaded to artifact store?
samir.k: SBOM uploaded to GCS at `gs://redwood-releases/sbom/rc3.json`. link: https://console.gcs/release/sbom/rc3.json
scanner-bot: Automated scan summary for `v2.4.7-rc3`:
- high: 0
- medium: 1 (pkg: openssl 1.1.1k -> note: backported fix available)
- low: 4
Full report: https://scans.internal/reports/1768123456
todd.security: saw the medium item. it’s a backported fix in our base image. mitigation options: pin to the patched base image `ubuntu-base:2026-02-08-patch` OR apply runtime mitigation (configure TLS_FALLBACK) — prefer pinning for patch parity.
maria: pinning base image will increase image size + rebuild time. if we pin, can we do a hotfix manifest change only so we don't need a full QA cycle?
chris: we should avoid extra QA cycles for infra-only base updates if config/API surface unchanged. ops: we can do a manifest-only rollout with version pin and smoke tests.
samir.k: proposed action: update deployment manifest to pin base image and regenerate SBOM, run smoke, then promote. rollback plan: revert manifest to `v2.4.7-rc2` tag + immediate traffic cutover. Example manifest snippet:
```yaml
image: redwood-inference:v2.4.7-rc3
baseImage: ubuntu-base:2026-02-08-patch
```
deploy-bot: Gate check triggered: SBOM present, vulnerability scan present, approvals required: 1 security, 1 release-eng. Current approvals: 0/2
lauren: I can do release-eng approval after smoke passes. samir — ping me when smoke is green.
todd.security: I’ll approve if SBOM regenerated and the baseImage pin is in the manifest. after that I can authorize the change for the change window.
samir.k: regenerating SBOM now, kicking smoke pipeline: `./ci/smoke.sh --image redwood-inference:v2.4.7-rc3 --base ubuntu-base:2026-02-08-patch`
scanner-bot: SBOM regenerated and uploaded: `gs://redwood-releases/sbom/rc3-20260318.json`. Fresh scan run queued.
scanner-bot: Fresh scan complete: 0 high, 0 medium, 3 low. No new findings.
lauren: smoke passed on canary (build 459). all good from release-eng :white_check_mark:
todd.security: verified SBOM and scan. approving security check :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Approvals satisfied. Scheduling promote to prod in change window (02:15 UTC).
samir.k: promote started. watching metrics and logs. will ping here if anything odd.
chris: thanks — reminder: if we see >3% error rate or latency +30% revert plan is to cut traffic back to rc2 and open incident.
samir.k: noted. will execute rollback if thresholds hit.
deploy-bot: Promote completed successfully. New prod image: `redwood-inference:v2.4.7-rc3` now at 100% traffic. :tada:
lauren: nice one. good coordination everyone.
todd.security: leaving a short note in the compliance ticket with SBOM link and approval timestamp.
samir.k: closing the release thread — logs and timelines: https://releases.internal/logs/1768123456
